integrity: Complete symbolic proof; reproducible finite representative checks are corroborative, not a universal computational certificate. No independent audit performed.
limitations: Finite connected simple graphs with at least one edge and no cycles of lengths three or four; only the scale-two complex and degree-one inclusion to scale two are determined. Higher scales are not classified; an unindexed equivalent prior proof may exist.
title: A scale-two Čech collapse theorem for line graphs of girth at least five
